name: Hunter Set
description: Standard attire worn by hunters who stalk and kill beasts. The cape and coat are made of high-quality materials, providing excellent defense against blood and pathogens.
origin: Standard issue for new hunters of the Workshop.

name: Yharnam Hunter Set
description: Attire of the hunters of old Yharnam, who dedicated themselves to the containment and eradication of the plague. Features a distinctive mask that filters out poisonous fumes.

name: Charred Hunter Set
description: Attire worn by hunters who ventured into flaming areas. The fabric has been treated with fire-resistant coating, scorched black by its many encounters with fire.
origin: Crafted by hunters who specialize in hunting fire beasts

name: Cainhurst Knight Set
description: Armor of the royal guards of Cainhurst Castle. The intricate silver plating provides excellent protection against physical attacks but is quite heavy.
origin: Cainhurst Castle, home of the nobles of blood

name: Tomb Prospector Set
description: Attire worn by the tomb prospectors of the Healing Church. Made with a special fabric that resists arcane attacks, essential for exploring the labyrinthine catacombs.
set_bonus: Advantage to Investigation when exploring dungeons

name: Crowfeather Set
description: Attire worn by the hunters of hunters. Light and allows for quick movement. The crow feather cape grants a mysterious power that helps track prey.
origin: Worn by Eileen the Crow and other hunters of hunters

name: Executioner Set
description: Gold ardor worn by the executioners of the Healing Church. The conical gold helmet symbolizes their resolve to cleanse the streets of the impure vilebloods.

name: Choir Set
description: Attire worn by the Choir, the highest ranking members of the Healing Church. Features a blindfold that enhances insight and communion with the Great Ones.
set_bonus: +2 to Arcane damage and +1d6 to Insight checks
origin: Upper Cathedral Ward, secret research division

name: Bone Ash Set
description: Attire of the old Keepers of the Old Lords, featuring a distinctive bone ash mask. Offers great fire protection with decent physical defense.
origin: Worn by the Keepers of the Old Lords in the Chalice Dungeons

name: White Church Set
description: The pure white attire worn by clerics of the Healing Church, specialists in blood ministration and antidotes. Offers good protection against poison.

name: Black Church Set
description: Attire worn by hunters of the Healing Church. The black garb signifies their role as specialized hunters who answer directly to the higher echelons of the Church.
set_bonus: Gain advantage to remove Bleed Status.

name: Student Uniform
description: Attire worn by the students of Byrgenwerth, the academic institute that discovered the old blood. Light clothing that allows free movement and has decent arcane resistance.

name: Madman's Set
description: Tattered garb worn by those who have lost their minds to frenzy and insight. Despite its ragged appearance, it offers remarkable protection against arcane and frenzy.
set_bonus: Immunity to first frenzy effect in combat
origin: Found among the insane patients of the Research Hall

name: Graveguard Set
description: Ancient burial clothes worn by the guardians of forbidden graves. Provides strong protection against arcane attacks and the maddening effects of insight.
origin: Ancient burial sites connected to the Pthumerians

name: Knight's Set
description: Heavy armor worn by knights who served in foreign lands before coming to Yharnam. Provides excellent physical protection at the cost of mobility.
origin: Foreign lands, brought to Yharnam by traveling knights

name: Doll Set
description: Elegant attire worn by the plain doll in the Hunter's Dream. Made with incredibly fine craftsmanship, it provides minimal protection but doesn't hinder movement.
set_bonus: Blood echo acquisition increased by 1 point
origin: Created by Gehrman for the Plain Doll in the Hunter's Dream

name: Ashen Hunter Set
description: Garb worn by hunters of the old workshop, charred by countless encounters with fire-breathing beasts. The ashen coating provides excellent resistance to flames.
set_bonus: Extinguish burning status with a free action
origin: Old Hunter's Workshop, forged in battle against fire beasts

name: Foreign Garb
description: Strange attire from lands far beyond Yharnam, offering protection against elemental forces rarely encountered in the city of blood.
